title: Show if-FC pp
description: During play, shows what the score would be worth as a full combo at the current accuracy, as a readout and an FC marker on the rail.

title: Show max achievable pp
description: During play, shows the most this attempt can still reach if every remaining object is hit perfectly; the hatched band on the rail runs from current pp to it.

title: Show accuracy ladder in song select
description: In song select, lists pp at 95, 97, 98, 99 and 100% accuracy for the selected map and mods, and notches those values on the rail.

title: Show pp breakdown
description: During play, splits current pp into its non-zero components: aim, speed, accuracy and flashlight for osu!; difficulty and accuracy for taiko, catch and mania.

title: Decimal places
description: Decimal places on pp readouts. The accuracy ladder and breakdown always show whole pp.

title: Show 18—LAB tag
description: Shows the 18—LAB tag in the panel header.
